## Pricing Strategy

### Value-Based Pricing

**Rationale**: Price based on value delivered (time savings, cost savings), not cost to produce.

**Justification**:
- Time savings: 12+ minutes/day = CAD $200+ monthly value
- Cost savings: CAD $200+ monthly (reduce food waste, cut takeout)
- ROI: 20x+ return on investment

---

### Competitive Pricing

**Comparison**:
- **Mealime**: USD $5.99/month (CAD $8.15) — No Canadian stores
- **Paprika**: USD $4.99 one-time — No grocery integration
- **Yummly**: Free (ads) or USD $4.99/month — Not meal-planning focused

**Our Position**: Slightly premium (CAD $9.99/month) justified by Canadian grocery integration and superior features.

---

### Pricing Psychology

**Anchoring**: Pro plan (CAD $19.99) makes Starter (CAD $9.99) seem affordable.

**Annual Discount**: 17% discount encourages annual subscriptions (improves cash flow, reduces churn).

**Free Tier**: Freemium model reduces friction, allows users to try before buying.

## GST/HST

### Tax Rate

**Ontario**: 13% HST (GST 5% + PST 8%)  
**Other Provinces**: Varies (see tax rates below)

**Tax Calculation**:
- Free: CAD $0 (no tax)
- Starter: CAD $9.99/month (includes GST/HST)
- Pro: CAD $19.99/month (includes GST/HST)

### Tax by Province

- **Ontario**: 13% HST
- **BC**: 12% HST (GST 5% + PST 7%)
- **AB, SK, MB, NT, NU, YT**: 5% GST only
- **QC**: 14.975% (GST 5% + QST 9.975%)
- **NB, NL, NS, PE**: 15% HST

**Note**: All prices include GST/HST. Tax rate determined by user's province.

## Pricing FAQs

### Q: Can I upgrade/downgrade?

**A**: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade anytime. Upgrades take effect immediately (prorated billing). Downgrades take effect at the end of the billing period.

### Q: Do you offer student discounts?

**A**: Yes, we offer 50% off for students (valid student email required). Contact support@whats-for-dinner.ca for details.

### Q: Can I cancel anytime?

**A**: Yes, you can cancel anytime. Your subscription remains active until the end of the billing period.

### Q: Is there a free trial?

**A**: Yes, the Free tier allows you to try the app. No credit card required for Free tier.

### Q: What happens if I cancel?

**A**: Your subscription remains active until the end of the billing period. After cancellation, your account downgrades to Free tier.
